summary.text: Katherine Robertson is the Republican nominee and chief counsel to Attorney General Steve Marshall. If elected she would be Alabama's first woman attorney general. She won a costly runoff against former Alabama Supreme Court Justice Jay Mitchell.

paragraphs.text: Chief counsel to Attorney General Steve Marshall.
Describes herself in her runoff-night speech as "a girl from Dallas County, Alabama" whose family grew cotton and ran the local post office.

sources.title: Robertson wins Alabama GOP attorney general runoff
